description: tangent-hole's hole, touching the plate's side face from inside, moved across the contact by four tolerances (1e-7), out through the face (d > 0) and in off it (d < 0): the ends of the band either side of the tangent contact, a clean cut either way. A quarter of a tolerance either way is the contact itself, boolean/tangent-hole-a-quarter-off (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).
